# <span id="aanchor319"></span> Distribution Lists

Distribution lists allow users to maintain lists of email addresses and send messages to all list members simultaneously. Use the Distribution Lists Editor to group contacts into distribution lists.

Contacts can belong to multiple distribution lists.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Distribution Lists Editor and create a new distribution list:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.

2.  Select **Distribution Lists** within the **Contacts** group.

3.  Go to **File** \> **New**.

4.  Enter a name for the distribution list and select an address book.

5.  Click **Save**.

    You cannot save until you have specified a name and an address book.

6.  Click the **Members** button.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 340;height: 181;" />

7.  Click the checkboxes next to contact names to include them in the distribution list.

8.  When you have finished selecting contacts, click **OK**.

    You can repeat steps 6 through 8 as many times as needed.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 401;height: 266;" />

9.  Click **Save**.

To delete a distribution list, go to **File** \> **Delete**.

To add or remove members, select the distribution list and click the **Members** button, or go to **Edit** \> **Add/Remove Members**.

To rename a distribution list or change the list information, select the distribution list and go to **Edit** \> **Rename/Change List Info**.

</div>

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Menu Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following menu options are available in the Distribution List Editor:

- **File**
  - **New** - Create new distribution list
  - **Delete** - Delete the selected distribution list
  - **Print** - Print a report of the selected distribution list and associated members
  - **Exit** - Close the Distribution List editor
- **Edit**
  - **Add/Remove Members** - Add or remove members from selected distribution list

    This functionality is also available when you click the **Members** button.

  - **Rename/Change List Info** - Change the name of the selected distribution list.

</div>
